title: Remove Covered Intervals
statement:
Each interval is half-open `[left, right)`. An interval is covered when another interval starts no later and ends no earlier. Remove all covered intervals and return the number that remain. The input intervals are unique.

## Examples

```text
Input: intervals = [[1, 4], [3, 6], [2, 8]]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: intervals = [[1, 4], [2, 3]]
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= intervals.length <= 1000`
- `0 <= left < right <= 10^5`
- All intervals are unique.
